name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.selfIntersectionJensen_image
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} {Δ : Type u_3} {I : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Ω] [Fintype Δ] [inst_2 : Fintype I]
  (P : PMF Ω) (Z : Ω → Γ) (U : Ω → Δ) (g : Γ → Δ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), U ω = g (Z ω)) →
    ∀ (u : Δ),
      (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) →
        ∀ (E : I → Ω → Prop),
          ∑ e : I, (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (E e) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) ^ 2 ≤
            ∑ z : ↥(Finset.image Z Finset.univ),
              (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = ↑z) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) *
                ∑ e : I, (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (E e) fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = ↑z) ^ 2

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historySelfIntersection_auxiliary
type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g : ℝ) (p : Fin k)
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (i : ℕ) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d i ω →
    ∀ {Z : Type u_1} (aux : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Z),
      RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historySelfIntersection cuts D g p d i ω ≤
        ∑ z :
          ↥(Finset.image
              (fun (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) => (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.naturalHistory cuts p d i v, aux v))
              Finset.univ),
          RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
              (fun (v : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.naturalHistory cuts p d i v, aux v) = ↑z)
              (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d i ω) *
            ∑ e : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p - 1),
              (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                  (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.remainingEdgeEvent cuts D g p d i e)
                  fun (v : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                  (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.naturalHistory cuts p d i v, aux v) = ↑z) ^
                2

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalExpect_atoms
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (H : Ω → Prop),
  RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P f H = ∑ ω : Ω, RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (fun (v : Ω) => v = ω) H * f ω

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalExpect_finite_tower
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} {Δ : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] [Fintype Δ] (P : PMF Ω)
  (Z : Ω → Γ) (U : Ω → Δ) (g : Γ → Δ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), U ω = g (Z ω)) →
    ∀ (u : Δ),
      (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) →
        ∀ (f : Ω → ℝ),
          (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P f fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) =
            ∑ z : Γ,
              (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = z) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) *
                RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P f fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = z

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalExpect_finite_image
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] (P : PMF Ω) (Z : Ω → Γ) (H : Ω → Prop),
  0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P H →
    ∀ (f : Γ → ℝ),
      RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => f (Z ω)) H =
        ∑ z : Γ, RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = z) H * f z

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalExpect_image
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (Z : Ω → Γ) (H : Ω → Prop),
  0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P H →
    ∀ (f : Γ → ℝ),
      RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => f (Z ω)) H =
        ∑ z : ↥(Finset.image Z Finset.univ), RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = ↑z) H * f ↑z

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.selfIntersectionJensen_expect
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} {Δ : Type u_3} {E : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Ω] [Fintype Δ] [inst_2 : Fintype E]
  (P : PMF Ω) (Z : Ω → Γ) (U : Ω → Δ) (g : Γ → Δ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), U ω = g (Z ω)) →
    ∀ (u : Δ),
      (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) →
        ∀ (event : E → Ω → Prop),
          ∑ e : E, (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (event e) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) ^ 2 ≤
            RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P
              (fun (ω : Ω) => ∑ e : E, (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (event e) fun (v : Ω) => Z v = Z ω) ^ 2)
              fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalExpect_tower
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} {Δ : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Ω] [Fintype Δ] (P : PMF Ω) (Z : Ω → Γ) (U : Ω → Δ)
  (g : Γ → Δ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), U ω = g (Z ω)) →
    ∀ (u : Δ),
      (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) →
        ∀ (f : Ω → ℝ),
          (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P
              (fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P f fun (v : Ω) => Z v = Z ω) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) =
            RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P f fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalScale
type:
∀ (a ξ A cH Ccur Csum K : ℝ),
  0 < a →
    0 < ξ →
      0 < cH →
        0 ≤ Ccur →
          0 ≤ Csum →
            0 ≤ K →
              ∃ (C : ℝ),
                0 < C ∧
                  ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                    2 ≤ N0 ∧
                      ∀ (N : ℕ),
                        N0 ≤ N →
                          ∀ (M r : ℝ),
                            0 ≤ M →
                              0 ≤ r →
                                r ≤ a / 4 →
                                  M ≤ K * Real.log ↑N * ↑N ^ r →
                                    (Ccur + M * Csum) * ↑N ^ (-a) +
                                        (↑N + 2 * M * ↑N ^ 2) * √(RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.badBound N ξ A cH) ≤
                                      C * ↑N ^ (-a / 2)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.fullWordMean_le_maximalMean

  ↑n * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts s ≤ RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hn

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.currentWordPower
type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) {η α : ℝ},
  0 < η →
    α ≤ 1 →
      α ≤ η / (40 * (1 + η)) →
        RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta n 0 cuts ⋯ (L + 1) ≤ -η →
          ↑n * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts s ^ (1 - α) ≤ ↑n ^ (-3 * η / 5)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.currentRunBound
type:
∀ (k D : ℕ),
  0 < k →
    1 ≤ D →
      ∀ (g τ T η : ℝ),
        0 < g →
          g < 1 →
            0 < τ →
              τ < g →
                0 < T →
                  0 < η →
                    Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) < 1 / 2 →
                      Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) ≤ η / (40 * (1 + η)) →
                        ∃ (Ccur : ℝ),
                          0 < Ccur ∧
                            ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                              2 ≤ N0 ∧
                                ∀ (n : ℕ),
                                  N0 ≤ n →
                                    ∀ (L : ℕ),
                                      ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑n →
                                        ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n),
                                          TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn 0) g →
                                            RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta n 0 cuts hn (L + 1) ≤ -η →
                                              ∀ (ξ ε : ℝ),
                                                0 ≤ ε →
                                                  ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
                                                    (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                                    (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                                    RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d (↑j + 1) ω →
                                                      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyGood cuts D g ξ ε p d (↑j + 1)
                                                          ω →
                                                        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g d
                                                            (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j) →
                                                          RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect
                                                              (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                              (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.currentExcess cuts p d j ω)
                                                              (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d (↑j + 1)
                                                                ω) ≤
                                                            Ccur * ↑n ^ (-3 * η / 5) + ↑n * ε

type:

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.currentRun_count_le_excess

  {e : Fin (m - 1) | i ≤ ↑e + 1 ∧ f ⟨↑e, ⋯⟩ = f ⟨↑e + 1, ⋯⟩ ∧ f ⟨↑e, ⋯⟩ = s}.card ≤
    RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tupleCount f s - RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.observedCount f i s

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.remainingCount_le_common

∀ {k n L : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g ξ : ℝ) (p : Fin k)
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (i : ℕ) (ω ω' : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.remainingDirectionalCount cuts D g ξ p d i ω ω' ≤

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.remaining_initial_le_firstMoment
type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g ξ : ℝ) (p : Fin k)
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),

        ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.remainingDirectionalCount cuts D g ξ p d 0 v.1 v.2))
      fun (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d 0 v = RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d 0 ω) ≤

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalProbability_le_one
type: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (E H : Ω → Prop), RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P E H ≤ 1

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalSquare_partition
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} {I : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype E] [inst_2 : Fintype I] (P : PMF Ω)
  (H : Ω → Prop) (event current : E → Ω → Prop) (block : I → E → Ω → Prop) (assign : E → Option I),
  (∀ (e : E) (ω : Ω),
      H ω →
        event e ω →
          match assign e with
          | none => current e ω
          | some a => block a e ω) →
    ∑ e : E, RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (event e) H ^ 2 ≤
      RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect P (fun (ω : Ω) => ↑{e : E | current e ω}.card) H +
        ∑ a : I, ∑ e : E, RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (block a e) H ^ 2

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalSquares_le_card
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype E] (P : PMF Ω) (H : Ω → Prop)
  (event : E → Ω → Prop),
  ∑ e : E, RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (event e) H ^ 2 ≤

  (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)) (x : I → RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),

type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [Fintype I] (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g : ℝ) (p : Fin k)
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
  (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)) (x : I → RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
  (∀ (a b : I), a ≠ b → RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.prefixSeparated (x a) (x b)) →
    (∀ (a : I) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
        RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (x a) w →
          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j) w) →
      (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
          List.Vector.get w 0 = p →
            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j) w →
              ∃ (a : I), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (x a) w) →
        ∃ (assign : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p - 1) → Option I),
          ∀ (e : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p - 1)) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
            RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.futureFamilyView cuts p d (↑j + 1)

                    RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.absoluteBlockGraph (x a) v

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.goodRefinement_exists
type:
∀ {k n L N : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n) {ρ γ g : ℝ},
  0 ≤ ρ →
    0 < γ →
      γ ≤ 1 →
        1 ≤ N →
          8 < γ * (ρ * Real.log ↑N) →
            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.integerWindowGood N cuts hn ρ γ g →
              ∀ (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
                ∃ (m : ℕ),
                  ↑x.fst + m ≤ L + 1 ∧
                    m ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ ∧
                      (↑x.fst + RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ ≤ L + 1 →
                          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.goodRefinement cuts hn γ g x m) ∧
                        (L + 1 < ↑x.fst + RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ → m = 0)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.chooseGoodRefinement
type:
∀ {k n L N : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n) {ρ γ g : ℝ},
  0 ≤ ρ →
    0 < γ →
      γ ≤ 1 →
        1 ≤ N →
          8 < γ * (ρ * Real.log ↑N) →
            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.integerWindowGood N cuts hn ρ γ g →
              ∀ (B : Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1))),
                ∃ (m : ↥B → ℕ),
                  (∀ (x : ↥B), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ L + 1) ∧
                    (∀ (x : ↥B), m x ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ) ∧
                      (∀ (x : ↥B),
                          ↑(↑x).fst + RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ ≤ L + 1 →
                            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.goodRefinement cuts hn γ g (↑x) (m x)) ∧
                        ∀ (x : ↥B), L + 1 < ↑(↑x).fst + RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ → m x = 0

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.chooseGoodRefinement_uniform
type:
∀ {ρ γ : ℝ},
  0 < ρ →
    0 < γ →
      γ ≤ 1 →
        ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
          2 ≤ N0 ∧
            ∀ (N : ℕ),
              N0 ≤ N →
                ∀ (k n L : ℕ) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n) (g : ℝ),
                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.integerWindowGood N cuts hn ρ γ g →
                    ∀ (B : Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1))),
                      ∃ (m : ↥B → ℕ),
                        (∀ (x : ↥B), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ L + 1) ∧
                          (∀ (x : ↥B), m x ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ) ∧
                            (∀ (x : ↥B),
                                ↑(↑x).fst + RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ ≤ L + 1 →
                                  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.goodRefinement cuts hn γ g (↑x) (m x)) ∧
                              ∀ (x : ↥B), L + 1 < ↑(↑x).fst + RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ → m x = 0

  (∀ (a b : I), a ≠ b → RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.prefixSeparated (x a) (x b)) →

        ∑ e : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p - 1),
            (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                (fun (v : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>

                    RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.absoluteBlockGraph (x a) v)

                    (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j) x ω) ^
              2 ≤
          RiffleUpperV2.expectedCommonEdges
            (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.inducedCuts cuts (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows (x a) ω) (x a) ω)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historyBlockAverage

    (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) →
      (p : Fin k) →
        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction →

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historySelfIntersection_family
type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} {I : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype I] (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g : ℝ) (p : Fin k)
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
  (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)) (x : I → RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d (↑j + 1) ω →
    (∀ (a b : I), a ≠ b → RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.prefixSeparated (x a) (x b)) →

          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (x a) w →
            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j) w) →

          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historySelfIntersection cuts D g p d (↑j + 1) ω ≤
            RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.currentExcess cuts p d j ω)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historyBlockAverage_le_count

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historyBlockAverage_le_collisions
type:

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historyBlockAverage_large

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalSquareJensen
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} {Δ : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] [Fintype Δ] (P : PMF Ω)
  (Z : Ω → Γ) (U : Ω → Δ) (g : Γ → Δ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), U ω = g (Z ω)) →
    ∀ (u : Δ),
      (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) →
        ∀ (E : Ω → Prop),
          (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P E fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) ^ 2 ≤
            ∑ z : Γ,
              (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = z) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) *
                (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P E fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = z) ^ 2

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.selfIntersectionJensen
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} {Δ : Type u_3} {I : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] [Fintype Δ]
  [inst_3 : Fintype I] (P : PMF Ω) (Z : Ω → Γ) (U : Ω → Δ) (g : Γ → Δ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), U ω = g (Z ω)) →
    ∀ (u : Δ),
      (0 < RiffleUpperV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) →
        ∀ (E : I → Ω → Prop),
          ∑ e : I, (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (E e) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) ^ 2 ≤
            ∑ z : Γ,
              (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = z) fun (ω : Ω) => U ω = u) *
                ∑ e : I, (RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability P (E e) fun (ω : Ω) => Z ω = z) ^ 2

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.crossHistorySquareBound

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.largeCylinder_concentration
type:
∀ (xi : ℝ),
  0 < xi →
    ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
      2 ≤ N0 ∧

          N0 ≤ N →

              (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.concentrationEvent cuts D g xi omega →
                ↑N ^ xi ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
                  RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x / 2 ≤ ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ∧
                    ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ≤ 2 * RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x ∧
                      2 ≤ (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ∧
                        (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ≤ N ∧
                          ∀ (hm : 0 < (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card) (j : Fin (L + 1 - ↑x.fst))
                            (a : Fin k),
                            |TimeProfile.prob
                                    (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile
                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.inducedCuts cuts
                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega) x omega)
                                      hm j)
                                    a -
                                  ↑(cuts.count (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.suffixColumn x j) a) / ↑N| ≤
                              2 * ↑N ^ (-xi / 3)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.largeCylinder_firstMoment
type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T eta g : ℝ),
      0 < T →

          0 < g →
            g < 1 / ↑k →

                  (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)) (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
                  ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                    RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N 0 cuts ⋯ (2 * eta) →
                      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.concentrationEvent cuts D g (eta / 10) omega →
                        ↑N ^ (eta / 10) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
                          (∃ (a : Fin (L + 1)),

                            RiffleUpperV2.expectedCommonEdges
                                (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.inducedCuts cuts (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega)
                                  x omega) ≤
                              ↑N ^ (-eta / 8)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.largeCylinder_sizeExponent
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ},
  0 < k →
    ∀ (hN : 2 ≤ N) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
      0 < (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card →
        0 < RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
          ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ≤ 2 * RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
            Real.log ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card / Real.log ↑N ≤
              1 - RiffleUpperV2.empiricalA N 0 cuts ⋯ 0 ↑x.fst + Real.log 2 / Real.log ↑N

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.largeCylinder_preservation
type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ (T eta g : ℝ),
      0 < eta →
        0 < g →
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            2 ≤ N0 ∧
              ∀ (N : ℕ),
                N0 ≤ N →
                  ∀ (hN : 2 ≤ N) (L : ℕ) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N (L + 1)) (D : ℕ)

                      RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N 0 cuts ⋯ (2 * eta) →

                              2 ≤ (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega).card ∧

                                          (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.cylinderRows x omega) x omega)

                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.inducedCuts cuts

                                        hm eta

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.lateShort_tiny_uniform
type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  1 ≤ k →
    ∀ (η ρ ξ : ℝ),

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalExpect_add

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalExpect_mul_const

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalExpect_sum

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.oneHistory_uniform
type:
∀ (k D : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    1 ≤ D →
      ∀ (T η g γ τ ρ A cH : ℝ),
        0 < T →
          0 < η →
            0 < g →
              g < 1 / ↑k →
                0 < γ →
                  γ ≤ 1 →
                    0 < τ →
                      τ < g →
                        0 < ρ →
                          0 < cH →
                            Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) < 1 / 2 →
                              Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) ≤ η / 10 / (4 * (1 + η / 10)) →
                                Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) ≤ η / (40 * (1 + η)) →
                                  ρ * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget η (η / 8) / 4 →
                                    ∃ (C : ℝ),
                                      0 < C ∧
                                        ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                                          2 ≤ N0 ∧
                                            ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                              N0 ≤ N →
                                                ∀ (L : ℕ) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N (L + 1)) (hN : 0 < N),
                                                  ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑N →
                                                    TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hN 0) g →
                                                      RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N 0 cuts hN (2 * η) →
                                                        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.integerWindowGood N cuts hN ρ γ g →
                                                          ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
                                                            (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                                            (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d (↑j + 1)
                                                                ω →
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyGood cuts D g (η / 10)
                                                                  (√(RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.badBound N (η / 10) A
                                                                      cH))
                                                                  p d (↑j + 1) ω →
                                                                RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historySelfIntersection cuts D
                                                                    g p d (↑j + 1) ω ≤
                                                                  C *
                                                                    ↑N ^
                                                                      (-RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget η
                                                                            (η / 8) /
                                                                        2)

type:

  (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),

type:

  (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),

      RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.independentPairLaw cuts)
        fun (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i v = RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i ω) ↔

type:

  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (i : ℕ),
  ↑n ^ ξ ≤ ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p) →
    ∀ (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),

            ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.remainingDirectionalCount cuts D g ξ p d i v.1 v.2))
          fun (v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts × RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) =>
          RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i v = RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i ω) =
        ∑ e : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p - 1),
          RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
              (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.remainingEdgeEvent cuts D g p d i e)
              (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d i ω.1) *
            RiffleUpperV2.conditionalProbability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)

            ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.remainingDirectionalCount cuts D g ξ p d i v.1 v.2))

          RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i v = RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pairHistory cuts p d i ω) ≤
        (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historySelfIntersection cuts D g p d i ω.1 +

          2

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget_pos

  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget η δF ≤ 3 * (η / 10) / 4 ∧
    RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget η δF ≤ 3 * η / 5 ∧ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget η δF ≤ δF

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.rareThreshold_exists
type: ∀ {g b : ℝ}, 0 < g → g < 1 → 0 < b → b < 1 → ∃ (τ : ℝ), 0 < τ ∧ τ < g ∧ Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) = b

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.conditionalParameter_choices
type:
∀ {k : ℕ},
  2 ≤ k →
    ∀ {η δF g : ℝ},
      0 < η →
        0 < δF →
          0 < g →
            g < 1 →
              ∃ (τ : ℝ) (ρ0 : ℝ),
                0 < τ ∧
                  τ < g ∧
                    0 < ρ0 ∧
                      Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) ≤ η / 10 / (4 * (1 + η / 10)) ∧
                        Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) ≤ η / (40 * (1 + η)) ∧
                          Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) < 1 / 2 ∧
                            ∀ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ ρ0 → ρ * Real.log ↑k ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget η δF / 4

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders
type: {k K : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.Word k K → RiffleUpperV2.Word k K → Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders_cover
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
  s ≤ w ∧ w < t ↔ ∃ x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t, RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders_depth_pos
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) {x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t → 0 < ↑x.fst

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders_disjoint
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) {x y : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t →
    y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t →
      ∀ {w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K},
        RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w → RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder y w → x = y

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders_parent_endpoint
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) {x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t →
    RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.parentList x <+: List.Vector.toList s ∨
      RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.parentList x <+: List.Vector.toList t

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders_antichain
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) {x y : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t →
    y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t →
      x ≠ y →
        ¬List.Vector.toList x.snd <+: List.Vector.toList y.snd ∧ ¬List.Vector.toList y.snd <+: List.Vector.toList x.snd

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders_child
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) {x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t →
    ∃ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k),
      x = RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.endpointChild s j a ∨ x = RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.endpointChild t j a

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders_card
type: ∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K), (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t).card ≤ 2 * k * K

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinderDecomposition
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
  (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t).card ≤ 2 * k * K ∧
    (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
        s ≤ w ∧ w < t ↔ ∃ x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t, RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t,
        ∀ y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pastCylinders s t,
          x ≠ y →
            ¬List.Vector.toList x.snd <+: List.Vector.toList y.snd ∧
              ¬List.Vector.toList y.snd <+: List.Vector.toList x.snd

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture
type: {k K : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction → RiffleUpperV2.Word k K → RiffleUpperV2.Word k K → Prop

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.firstDigit_prefix
type: ∀ {k L : ℕ} (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) (p : Fin k), List.Vector.get w 0 = p ↔ [p] <+: List.Vector.toList w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.firstDigit_interval
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} {s t w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)} {p : Fin k},
  List.Vector.get s 0 = p → List.Vector.get t 0 = p → s ≤ w → w ≤ t → List.Vector.get w 0 = p

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileWordSet
type: {k L : ℕ} → Fin k → Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1))

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileTop
type: {k L : ℕ} → (p : Fin k) → (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) → List.Vector.get s 0 = p → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileBottom
type: {k L : ℕ} → (p : Fin k) → (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) → List.Vector.get s 0 = p → RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileTop_first
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p),
  List.Vector.get (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileTop p s hs) 0 = p

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileBottom_first
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p),
  List.Vector.get (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileBottom p s hs) 0 = p

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders
type:
{k L : ℕ} →
  (p : Fin k) →
    RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction →
      (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)) → List.Vector.get s 0 = p → Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1))

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders_cover
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1))
  (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
  List.Vector.get w 0 = p ∧ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d s w ↔
    ∃ x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs, RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders_card
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1))
  (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p), (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs).card ≤ 2 * k * (L + 1)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders_depth_pos
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1))
  (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p) {x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs → 0 < ↑x.fst

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders_antichain
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1))
  (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p) {x y : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)},
  x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs →
    y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs →
      x ≠ y →
        ¬List.Vector.toList x.snd <+: List.Vector.toList y.snd ∧ ¬List.Vector.toList y.snd <+: List.Vector.toList x.snd

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords_future_or_current
type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
  (ω v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d (↑j + 1) ω v →
    ∀ (r : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
      j ≤ r →
        RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d v r = RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j ∨
          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j)
            (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d v r)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.current_hasDirection_of_remaining
type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g : ℝ) (p : Fin k)
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (ω v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
  (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d (↑j + 1) ω v →
    ∀ (e : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p - 1)),
      ↑j + 1 ≤ ↑e + 1 →
        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.directionalEdge cuts D g p d e v →
          RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g d (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_iff_take
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w ↔ List.take (↑x.fst) (List.Vector.toList w) = List.Vector.toList x.snd

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_exists
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K),
  ∃ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.prefixFirst_of_cylinder
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)) (hx : 0 < ↑x.fst),
  (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w → List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
    List.Vector.get x.snd ⟨0, hx⟩ = p

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailBinPrefix_of_first
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)) (hx : 0 < ↑x.fst),
  List.Vector.get x.snd ⟨0, hx⟩ = p →
    ∃ (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min (↑x.fst - 1) L)), RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix (↑x.fst - 1) p v = x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailBinPrefix_of_cylinder
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
  0 < ↑x.fst →
    (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)), RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w → List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
      ∃ (E : ℕ) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min E L)), RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix E p v = x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder_tailBinPrefix
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (E : ℕ) (p : Fin k) (v : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (min E L)) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailBinPrefix E p v) w ↔
    List.Vector.get w 0 = p ∧ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.tailPrefix E w = v

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.preparedFamily_exists
type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  1 ≤ k →
    ∀ (η ρ ξ γ : ℝ),
      0 < ρ →
        0 < γ →
          γ ≤ 1 →
            ξ < η - ρ * Real.log ↑k →
              ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                2 ≤ N0 ∧
                  ∀ (N : ℕ),
                    N0 ≤ N →
                      ∀ (L : ℕ) (T : ℝ),
                        ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑N →
                          ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N (L + 1)) (hN : 0 < N) (g : ℝ),
                            RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.integerWindowGood N cuts hN ρ γ g →
                              RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta N 0 cuts hN (L + 1) ≤ -η →
                                ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
                                  (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                  List.Vector.get s 0 = p →
                                    ∃ (B : Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1))),
                                      ↑B.card ≤ 2 * ↑k ^ 3 * T * Real.log ↑N * ↑N ^ (ρ * Real.log ↑k) ∧
                                        (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                            List.Vector.get w 0 = p ∧ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d s w ↔
                                              ∃ x ∈ B, RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w) ∧
                                          (∀ x ∈ B, 0 < ↑x.fst) ∧
                                            (∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ B, x ≠ y → RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.prefixSeparated x y) ∧
                                              ∀ x ∈ B,
                                                RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x < ↑N ^ (-ξ) ∨
                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.goodRefinement cuts hN γ g x 0

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.extendPrefix
type:
{k K : ℕ} →
  (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) → (m : ℕ) → ↑x.fst + m ≤ K → RiffleUpperV2.Word k m → RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineCylinder
type: {k K : ℕ} → (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) → (m : ℕ) → ↑x.fst + m ≤ K → Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily
type:
{k K : ℕ} →
  (B : Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K)) →
    (m : ↥B → ℕ) → (∀ (x : ↥B), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ K) → Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineCylinder_card
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) (m : ℕ) (hm : ↑x.fst + m ≤ K),
  (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineCylinder x m hm).card ≤ k ^ m

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily_card
type:
∀ {k K b : ℕ},
  1 ≤ k →
    ∀ (B : Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K)) (m : ↥B → ℕ) (hm : ∀ (x : ↥B), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ K),
      (∀ (x : ↥B), m x ≤ b) → (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily B m hm).card ≤ B.card * k ^ b

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refinedFuture_card
type:
∀ {k K N : ℕ} {ρ T : ℝ},
  1 ≤ k →
    1 ≤ N →
      0 ≤ ρ →
        ↑K ≤ T * Real.log ↑N →
          ∀ (s t : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K) (m : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders s t) → ℕ)
            (hm : ∀ (x : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders s t)), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ K),
            (∀ (x : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders s t)),
                m x ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ) →
              ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.futureCylinders s t) m hm).card ≤
                2 * ↑k ^ 3 * T * Real.log ↑N * ↑N ^ (ρ * Real.log ↑k)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineCylinder_extension
type:
∀ {k K m : ℕ} (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) (hm : ↑x.fst + m ≤ K) {y : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
  y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineCylinder x m hm →
    ↑y.fst = ↑x.fst + m ∧ List.Vector.toList x.snd <+: List.Vector.toList y.snd

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineCylinder_cover
type:
∀ {k K m : ℕ} (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) (hm : ↑x.fst + m ≤ K) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
  RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w ↔
    ∃ y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineCylinder x m hm, RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder y w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily_cover
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (B : Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K)) (m : ↥B → ℕ) (hm : ∀ (x : ↥B), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ K)
  (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
  (∃ x ∈ B, RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w) ↔
    ∃ y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily B m hm, RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder y w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily_antichain
type:
∀ {k K : ℕ} (B : Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K)) (m : ↥B → ℕ) (hm : ∀ (x : ↥B), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ K),
  (∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ B, x ≠ y → ¬List.Vector.toList x.snd <+: List.Vector.toList y.snd) →
    ∀ {a b : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K},
      a ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily B m hm →
        b ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily B m hm →
          List.Vector.toList a.snd <+: List.Vector.toList b.snd → a = b

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.window_power_le
type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {ρ : ℝ},
  1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ N → 0 ≤ ρ → ↑k ^ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ ≤ ↑k ^ 2 * ↑N ^ (ρ * Real.log ↑k)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refinementCount
type:
∀ {k N K M : ℕ} {ρ T : ℝ},
  1 ≤ k →
    1 ≤ N →
      0 ≤ ρ →
        ↑K ≤ T * Real.log ↑N →
          M ≤ 2 * k * K * k ^ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ →
            ↑M ≤ 2 * ↑k ^ 3 * T * Real.log ↑N * ↑N ^ (ρ * Real.log ↑k)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.regimeBlockAverage_uniform
type:
∀ (k D : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    1 ≤ D →
      ∀ (T η g τ : ℝ),
        0 < T →
          0 < η →
            0 < g →
              g < 1 / ↑k →
                0 < τ →
                  τ < g →
                    Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) < 1 / 2 →
                      Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) ≤ η / 10 / (4 * (1 + η / 10)) →
                        Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / τ) ≤ η / (40 * (1 + η)) →
                          ∃ (Csum : ℝ),
                            0 < Csum ∧
                              ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                                2 ≤ N0 ∧
                                  ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                    N0 ≤ N →
                                      ∀ (L : ℕ) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N (L + 1)) (hN : 0 < N),
                                        ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑N →
                                          TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hN 0) g →
                                            RiffleUpperV2.EmpiricalNegativeMargin N 0 cuts hN (2 * η) →
                                              ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                                                0 ≤ ε →
                                                  ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
                                                    (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                                    (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                                    RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d (↑j + 1) ω →
                                                      RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyGood cuts D g (η / 10) ε p d
                                                          (↑j + 1) ω →
                                                        RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g d
                                                            (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j) →
                                                          ∀ (I : Type) [Fintype I]
                                                            (x : I → RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
                                                            (∀ (a b : I),
                                                                a ≠ b →
                                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.prefixSeparated (x a) (x b)) →
                                                              ∀ (a : I),
                                                                0 < ↑(x a).fst →
                                                                  (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                                      RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (x a) w →
                                                                        List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
                                                                    (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                                        RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder (x a) w →
                                                                          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d
                                                                            (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts
                                                                              p d ω j)
                                                                            w) →
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts (x a) <
                                                                            ↑N ^ (-(η / 10)) ∨
                                                                          ∃ (c : Fin (L + 1)),
                                                                            ↑c = ↑(x a).fst ∧
                                                                              TimeProfile.GoodColumn
                                                                                (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hN c)
                                                                                g) →
                                                                        RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.historyBlockAverage
                                                                            cuts p d j x a ω ≤
                                                                          Csum *
                                                                              ↑N ^
                                                                                (-RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.decayBudget
                                                                                    η (η / 8)) +
                                                                            2 * ↑N ^ 2 * ε

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCount_power
type: ∀ {N lam ξ α : ℝ}, 0 < N → 0 ≤ lam → α ≤ 1 → N * lam ≤ N ^ (-ξ) → N * lam ^ (1 - α) ≤ N ^ (-ξ + α * (1 + ξ))

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCollision_power
type:
∀ {N lam qstar ξ η α tail : ℝ},
  0 < N →
    0 ≤ lam →
      0 ≤ qstar →
        α ≤ 1 / 2 →
          N * lam ≤ N ^ ξ →
            qstar ≤ N ^ (-η + ξ) →
              tail ≤ qstar ^ (1 - 2 * α) →
                N ^ 2 * lam ^ (2 * (1 - α)) * tail ≤ N ^ (-η + 3 * ξ + 2 * α * (1 + η - 2 * ξ))

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.directionalGlobalEdge_word
type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g : ℝ) (p : Fin k)
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (e : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p - 1))
  (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.directionalEdge cuts D g p d e ω →
    RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord ω (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.directionalGlobalEdge cuts p d e)) =
      RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω ⟨↑e, ⋯⟩

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.remainingEdge_cover
type:
∀ {k n L : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (D : ℕ) (g : ℝ) (p : Fin k)
  (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (ω v : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
  (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d (↑j + 1) ω v →
    ∀ (B : Finset (RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1))),
      (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
          List.Vector.get w 0 = p →
            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j) w →
              ∃ x ∈ B, RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w) →
        ∀ (e : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p - 1)),
          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.remainingEdgeEvent cuts D g p d (↑j + 1) e v →
            e ∈
                RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.currentRunEdges cuts p d (↑j + 1)
                  (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.revealWords cuts p d ω j) v ∨
              ∃ x ∈ B,
                ↑↑(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.directionalGlobalEdge cuts p d e) ∈
                  RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.absoluteBlockGraph x v

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refinedPileFuture_cover
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1))
  (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p) (m : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs) → ℕ)
  (hm : ∀ (x : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs)), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ L + 1)
  (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
  List.Vector.get w 0 = p ∧ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.strictFuture d s w ↔
    ∃ x ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs) m hm,
      RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refinedPileFuture_depth_pos
type:
∀ {k L : ℕ} (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1))
  (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p) (m : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs) → ℕ)
  (hm : ∀ (x : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs)), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ L + 1)
  {y : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)},
  y ∈ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs) m hm → 0 < ↑y.fst

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refinedPileFuture_card
type:
∀ {k L N : ℕ} {ρ T : ℝ},
  1 ≤ k →
    1 ≤ N →
      0 ≤ ρ →
        ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑N →
          ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction) (s : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1))
            (hs : List.Vector.get s 0 = p) (m : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs) → ℕ)
            (hm : ∀ (x : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs)), ↑(↑x).fst + m x ≤ L + 1),
            (∀ (x : ↥(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs)),
                m x ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ) →
              ↑(RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.refineFamily (RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.pileFutureCylinders p d s hs) m
                      hm).card ≤
                2 * ↑k ^ 3 * T * Real.log ↑N * ↑N ^ (ρ * Real.log ↑k)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tinyCylinder_count
type:
∀ (k D : ℕ),
  0 < k →
    1 ≤ D →
      ∀ (g tau T : ℝ),
        0 < g →
          g < 1 →
            0 < tau →
              tau < g →
                0 < T →
                  Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / tau) < 1 / 2 →
                    ∃ (C1 : ℝ),
                      0 < C1 ∧
                        ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                          2 ≤ N0 ∧
                            ∀ (n : ℕ),
                              N0 ≤ n →
                                ∀ (L : ℕ),
                                  ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑n →
                                    ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n),
                                      TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn 0) g →
                                        ∀ (xi epsilon : ℝ),
                                          0 ≤ epsilon →
                                            ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
                                              (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                              (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d (↑j + 1) omega →
                                                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyGood cuts D g xi epsilon p d (↑j + 1)
                                                    omega →
                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g d
                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d j)) →
                                                    ∀ (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
                                                      0 < ↑x.fst →
                                                        (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →
                                                              List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
                                                          (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →
                                                                match d with
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward =>
                                                                  RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j) <
                                                                    w
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward =>
                                                                  w <
                                                                    RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j)) →
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x ≤ ↑n ^ (-xi) →
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect
                                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                                  (fun (z : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                                    ↑(RiffleUpperV2.prefixCount x z))
                                                                  (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d
                                                                    (↑j + 1) omega) ≤
                                                                C1 *
                                                                    ↑n ^
                                                                      (-xi +
                                                                        Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / tau) *
                                                                          (1 + xi)) +
                                                                  ↑n * epsilon

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediateCylinder_collisions
type:
∀ (k D : ℕ),
  0 < k →
    1 ≤ D →
      ∀ (g tau T : ℝ),
        0 < g →
          g < 1 →
            0 < tau →
              tau < g →
                0 < T →
                  Real.log (1 / g) / Real.log (1 / tau) < 1 / 2 →
                    ∃ (C2 : ℝ),
                      0 < C2 ∧
                        ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
                          2 ≤ N0 ∧
                            ∀ (n : ℕ),
                              N0 ≤ n →
                                ∀ (L : ℕ),
                                  ↑(L + 1) ≤ T * Real.log ↑n →
                                    ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n (L + 1)) (hn : 0 < n),
                                      TimeProfile.GoodColumn (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hn 0) g →
                                        ∀ (xi eta epsilon : ℝ),
                                          0 ≤ epsilon →
                                            ∀ (p : Fin k) (d : RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction)
                                              (omega : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts)
                                              (j : Fin (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pileSize cuts p)),
                                              RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.positiveHistory cuts p d (↑j + 1) omega →
                                                RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyGood cuts D g xi epsilon p d (↑j + 1)
                                                    omega →
                                                  RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.hasDirection cuts D g d
                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                        (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d j)) →
                                                    ∀ (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k (L + 1)),
                                                      0 < ↑x.fst →
                                                        (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                            RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →
                                                              List.Vector.get w 0 = p) →
                                                          (∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1)),
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x w →
                                                                match d with
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.forward =>
                                                                  RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j) <
                                                                    w
                                                                | RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.Direction.backward =>
                                                                  w <
                                                                    RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord omega
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.pilePosition cuts p d
                                                                        j)) →
                                                            ↑n ^ (-xi) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
                                                              RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x ≤ ↑n ^ xi →
                                                                RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta n 0 cuts hn (L + 1) ≤ -eta →
                                                                  RiffleUpperV2.conditionalExpect
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                                                      (fun (z : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                                                        ∑ w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k (L + 1),
                                                                          if
                                                                              RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.inCylinder x
                                                                                w then
                                                                            ↑((RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.wordCount z
                                                                                    w).choose
                                                                                2)
                                                                          else 0)
                                                                      (RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.historyFiber cuts p d
                                                                        (↑j + 1) omega) ≤
                                                                    C2 *
                                                                        ↑n ^
                                                                          (-eta + 3 * xi +
                                                                            2 *
                                                                                (Real.log (1 / g) /
                                                                                  Real.log (1 / tau)) *
                                                                              (1 + eta - 2 * xi)) +
                                                                      ↑n ^ 2 * epsilon

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass
type: {k n K : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K → 0 < n → RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K → ℝ

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass_pos
type:
∀ {k n K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K),
  0 < RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass cuts hn x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.prefixMean_mul_maximalTail_le
type:
∀ {k n K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K),
  RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x * RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass cuts hn x ≤
    RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hn

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailColumnCount
type: ∀ {K r : ℕ}, r ≤ K → {j : Fin K | ¬↑j < r}.card = K - r

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass_lower
type:
∀ {k n K : ℕ},
  0 < k →
    ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K),
      (1 / ↑k) ^ (K - ↑x.fst) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass cuts hn x

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.shortPrefixMean_le
type:
∀ {k n K N b : ℕ},
  0 < k →
    2 ≤ N →
      ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K),
        K - ↑x.fst ≤ b →
          ∀ {η : ℝ},
            RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta N 0 cuts hn K ≤ -η → RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x ≤ ↑k ^ b * ↑N ^ (-η)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.lateShortMean_le
type:
∀ {k n K N : ℕ},
  1 ≤ k →
    2 ≤ N →
      ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) {η ρ : ℝ},
        0 ≤ ρ →
          K - ↑x.fst ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Exploration.windowLength N ρ →
            RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta N 0 cuts hn K ≤ -η →
              RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x ≤ ↑k ^ 2 * ↑N ^ (-η + ρ * Real.log ↑k)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.powerSum_le_max_power
type:
∀ {k : ℕ} (p : TimeProfile.Simplex k) {q : ℝ},
  1 < q → ∑ a : Fin k, TimeProfile.prob p a ^ q ≤ TimeProfile.pileMax p ^ (q - 1)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.tailPowerMass_le_maximalTail
type:
∀ {k n K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) {q : ℝ},
  1 < q → RiffleUpperV2.Reservoir.tailPowerMass cuts x q ≤ RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass cuts hn x ^ (q - 1)

name: RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.intermediate_maximalTail_le
type:
∀ {k n K N : ℕ},
  2 ≤ N →
    ∀ (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k n K) (hn : 0 < n) (x : RiffleUpperV2.Prefix k K) {η ξ : ℝ},
      ↑N ^ (-ξ) ≤ RiffleUpperV2.prefixMean cuts x →
        RiffleUpperV2.empiricalBeta N 0 cuts hn K ≤ -η →
          RiffleUpperV2.Conditional.maximalTailMass cuts hn x ≤ ↑N ^ (-η + ξ)
